definitions.explanation: The sixth month of the year. Known as the rainy season (梅雨, tsuyu) in most of Japan.

examples.japanese: {六月|ろくがつ}は{雨|あめ}が{多|おお}いです。
examples.english: There's a lot of rain in June.

examples.japanese: {六月|ろくがつ}は{暑|あつ}くなります。
{六月|ろくがつ}に{梅雨|つゆ}が{始|はじ}まります。
examples.english: The rainy season starts in June.

examples.japanese: {六月|ろくがつ}の{終|お}わりごろ、やっと{晴|は}れの{日|ひ}が{多|おお}くなります。
examples.english: Around the end of June, sunny days finally become more frequent.

examples.japanese: {六月|ろくがつ}に{外|そと}へ{出|で}かけるときは、{傘|かさ}を{持|も}っていったほうがいいですよ。
examples.english: When going out in June, you'd better bring an umbrella.

notes:
{六月|ろくがつ} is June, the sixth month of the year.

PATTERN:
Japanese months use number + {月|がつ}: {一月|いちがつ}, {二月|にがつ}, etc.

CULTURAL NOTES:
- Most of Japan (except Hokkaido) experiences {梅雨|つゆ} (rainy season) in June
- Despite the rain, "June bride" (ジューンブライド) weddings are popular due to Western influence
- {衣替|ころもが}え (seasonal clothing change) traditionally happens June 1st

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {六月|ろくがつ}{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}: mid-June
- {六月|ろくがつ}{上旬|じょうじゅん}: early June
- {六月|ろくがつ}{下旬|げじゅん}: late June

RELATED:
- {梅雨入|つゆい}り: start of rainy season
- {梅雨明|つゆあ}け: end of rainy season
